test_captured_output: test that captured_output writes a message to stdout via the pybind11 iostream module
test_captured_err: test that captured_err writes a message to stderr via the pybind11 iostream module
test_ostream_redirect: test the ostream_redirect context manager to redirect C++ stdout and stderr to Python
test_captured_dual: test that captured_dual writes separate messages to both stdout and stderr simultaneously
test_threading: test that ostream_redirect works safely across multiple concurrent C++ threads
